purpose: Prevent wrong-century geometries and licensing violations

records.label: Natural Earth
records.coverage: modern physical geography and contemporary political boundaries
records.use: global contextual basemap ONLY; never reconstructs past British control
records.technical: Vector and raster in three scales 1:10m/50m/110m; shape != historical state

records.label: CShapes 2.0 (LoC hosted)
records.use: candidate historical state-level polygons from late 19th c.; NOT early-modern/inner effective control
records.technical: GeoJSON, SHP, CSV available; verify specific distribution rights and field date semantics before reuse

records.label: World Historical Gazetteer
records.coverage: global historical place records contributed across eras
records.use: time-aware name matching and toponyms; geographic point only helps identification
records.license_class: mixed; WHG curation CC-BY-NC-4.0 PLUS individual source licenses
records.technical: API tokens for most endpoints; source attribution redistributable flag; no blind bulk crawling; 451 responses for restricted sources

records.label: National Library of Scotland historical maps API
records.use: landmarks and modern-historical change references, not 16th c. political lines
records.license_class: free layer under defined conditions; subscriptions for others; sheet-specific rights may vary
records.technical: APIs may be hosted by paid providers; TOS, tile traffic, attribution to be verified

records.label: Survey of India sheet 58 J/16 (1928–29 surveyed, 1930 published)
records.source: National Library of Scotland / Survey of India
records.use: proof of per-sheet archived India map availability and reuse statements
records.license_class: CC-BY NLS for this exact sheet as labelled
records.technical: individual sheets may have download PDF, IIIF or georef; do not extrapolate rights to all NLS holdings

records.label: GeoNames
records.coverage: global modern geonames and some historical variants; temporal control not specified
records.use: optional place-name disambiguation only, never as period-accurate jurisdiction
records.technical: web service credit/usage limits; downloads available

records.label: Down Survey historic GIS
records.coverage: Irish cadastral surveys 1656–58, land ownership associated 1641/1670
records.use: land parcel evidence and ownership transfer; NOT political boundary default
records.license_class: site © All rights reserved; specific data reuse not established
records.technical: Surviving scans + GIS assembled from originals and copies; provenance should be tracked by parish/barony

global_rules: Historical map evidence is not automatically an effective territorial control polygon.
Document publication or archive map date must be stored separately from dated geographic situation.
A data source's landing-page right to view is not permission to scrape or redistribute imagery.
GeoJSON lon-lat order, Leaflet layer lat-lng order: store CRS and order per file.
Document uncertainty polygons and conflicting alternative maps rather than fabricating a single hard boundary.
